Silky Crayons Review - Flanders Family Home Life

# Silky Crayons Review

Timberdoodle sent me a set of Silky Crayons to review this summer, and my grandkids love them. We’ve been using them for months!

The colors — twenty-four in all — are bright and vibrant. They provide great coverage, and will even show up on black paper.

The crayons themselves are virtually unbreakable. They never dry out and never need to be sharpened.

Best of all, the set is plenty big enough to share and has multiple shades of red, orange, yellow, green, blue, and purple, so nobody is forced to wait long for the color they need.

We took our Silky Crayons camping with us last week, and they helped keep my kids, grandkids, and even a few neighbors happily occupied while their parents visited around the campfire.

And just look at that smooth coverage! A red marker would have run out of ink before finishing that job. A red map pencil would not have been nearly so bright. And a regular red crayon would have likely broken in half long before the job was done.

The only caution I would give is that the pigments adhere better to normal paper with a matte finish. They tended to rub off a little when we used them on the slick poster-board craft project above.

But that never seemed to be a problem when we were using regular copy or construction paper or card stock.

Do you have a young artist who’d enjoy a set of Silky Crayons at your house? You can order your own through Timberdoodle as a stand-alone product or as part of their 2023 Preschool Curriculum Kit.

And while you’re on the Timberdoodle website, I’d encourage you to look around. We love everything we’ve ever ordered from this small family-owned company!

Be sure to sign up for their Doodle Dollar program to save on future purchases. And to see more of my Timberdoodle Reviews, simply scroll to the bottom of my Homeschool Help page, and you can read them all!

PLEASE NOTE: As a member of the Timberdoodle blog team, I routinely receive free or deeply discounted products in exchange for writing honest reviews. Opinions expressed in these posts are 100% my own. I’ve been a happy and enthusiastic Timberdoodle customer for decades — long before I ever started blogging for their company.

# ZEYAR Twistable Crayons, Non Toxic Washable Silky Crayons, 24 Assorted Colors, Safe to use, Cute Art School Supplies & Gifts (Seasons, 24 Colors)
Brand: ZEYAR
Category: Drawing Media > Crayons

## Features
USA Brand ZEYAR. We want everyone to fully love the crayons in their hand, the 24 colors crayons can stimulate their inner creativity and imagination. We develop Twistable Crayons to help people develop their color perception and express their feelings while coloring, drawing and doodling.; COMFORTABLE DESIGN Short and round body can fit good into your pocket and easy to hold; simple and clear appearance design; WIDE RANGE OF COLORS We have 8 Spring Colors Light Ivory, Sakura, Oman Yellow, Apricot, Quartz Violet, Lithops Helmutii, Scallion, White Green; 8 Autumn Colors Yellow Peaches, Plum Pink, Vintage Violet, Coral Red, Cinnabar, Lotus Green, Mustard, Mars Green; 8 Winter Colors Jasper Stone, Fairy Pink, Copper Brown, Smoky Blue, Sky Cold Blue, Amethyst, Azure Blue, Light Red Violet; SILKY & WASHABLE These twistable crayons glide as smooth as silk and easy to color. When drawing time is over, simply wash away with soap and warm water, it will not be stained.; TWISTABLE DESIGN Twist-Up Gel Stick Design, can be sharpened for finer tip, great for creative journaling. The rotating case protects the crayons from breaking easily and creates less mess when doodling.; INK CERTIFICATED Water Based and washable, conforms to ASTM D-4236 certificate, non-toxic, acid free and safe to use; WE CARE ABOUT ALL CUSTOMERS Here at ZEYAR, we are professional markers manufacturer with sophisticated R&D, Quality control processes to ensure all our products maintain great quality. For us, drawing is an expression of the human feelings and experience. That’s why we work to make Our markers supplies accessible to all people.

## Specifications
Ink Color: Blue,Pink,White; Material Type: Wax; Additional Features: Non-Toxic; Writing Instrument Form: Crayon; Drill Point: Fine

## Pricing & Reviews
Rated 3.9 from 70 reviews.
Top review: I didn't buy these to highlight and I am not into bible journaling, I bought them because they resemble the "silky" "gel crayons" and I liked the soft muted tones. They fill some color gaps with the gel crayons I have from other brands and while they are a little dryer, they still play nice and are fun to use for some loose art. I like using them to fill up backgrounds in my sketchbooks and doodle. Don't get these if you want something translucent, they are opaque. I would compare them to an oil pastel, but water based and they wash off of skin easily. I like that after a day or so they dry, unlike oil pastels.

ASIN: B0BV1KC2S4
